game_title: The Lost Legacy of C · C origins
game_concept: A tower defense set in Shadow Cave – Torchlit Cave Mouth, the torchlit cave entrance: the knight must handle zombies while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Door Defense: Push to repair the wooden door while the while-loop condition stays true and zombies keep attacking.
theme: Shadow Cave – Torchlit Cave Mouth: the torchlit cave entrance
core_gameplay_loop: Search the archive, examine recovered computing artifacts, and use their evidence to verify the assigned C lesson.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Case 1: Find 5 artifacts, read the evidence, and verify three findings about C origins.
controls: Select objects in the room. Review discovered objects in Evidence and verify your findings. Tab and Enter select controls. Escape closes a card or pauses.
win_condition: Recover all 5 artifacts and answer all three evidence checks correctly.
lose_condition: The case ends when the available incorrect evidence checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared archive artwork, illustrated artifacts, and Kenney interface audio.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Door Defense' (Week 4 slot 1), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Torchlit Cave Mouth'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Introduction to C: History, Characteristics and Classification

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Match the silhouettes in the tray to the objects in the room.
Inspect each artifact to read its history.
Open Evidence to review the records and verify your findings.
source_player_objective: Protect the wooden door from zombies in Torchlit Cave Mouth: keep the door_health meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 42-second timer ends.
source_lose_condition: door_health drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 42-second timer ends.
hint: Match an unfound object in the tray to its shape in the room. The Evidence folder keeps every record you uncover.
